desc: The development of the Trijicon VCOG 1-8x28 riflescope was inspired by requests from the U.S. Military. The result is a tough-as-nails, absolutely precise riflescope that gives users the ability to engage targets from CQB to long range with confidence. Expect superior glass that provides exceptional clarity and color with zero distortion. Choose from MOA or MRAD reticles.
